title: Citus: backup restore round-trip (reload + count)
description: Runs `nexus backup restore citus <id>`: the operator creates a throwaway citus_restore_verify DB it owns, recreates plain (non-distributed) tables, COPYs the rows back in, and counts events — proving the full distributed dataset round-trips.

observe.what: items restored = 800 (the full distributed events dataset, pulled + reloaded via the operator)

whatProves: CitusAdapter.BackupRestoreAsync reloads each CSV.gz into a scratch DB the operator owns on the coordinator and counts the events rows (the round-trip proof). backup restore takes the id positionally.
